tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in clean, transparent watch glass or glass dish to detect any foreign particles, conformance of colour & compliance with the visual specifications.

details.reference: BP 2024 Monograph for Synthetic Retinol Concentrate (Oily Form)

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg of sample in a stoppered tube, add 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min; stepwise add 0.9 mL, 2 mL, 7 mL; then 10 mg in 10 mL, 1 mg in 10 mL to classify solubility. Repeat with anhydrous ethanol.

details.reference: BP 2024 (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs; BP 2024 Monograph for Synthetic Retinol Concentrate (Oily Form)

tests.procedure: Alternative method for Identification (described under assay): The absorption maximum of the solution lies between 325 nm and 327 nm.

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix II B. Ultraviolet and Visible Absorption Spectrophotometry

tests.procedure: Dissolve 2.0 g (m) in 50 mL of equal volumes of ethanol (96%) and light petroleum R3 previously neutralised with 0.1 M KOH or 0.1 M NaOH using 0.5 mL phenolphthalein R1. If necessary heat to ~90 °C. Titrate with 0.1 M KOH or 0.1 M NaOH until pink colour persists for at least 15 s (n mL). Acid value IA = 5.61 x n / m.

details.solvent: 50 mL ethanol (96%) : light petroleum R3 (1:1 V/V)
details.titrant: 0.1 M potassium hydroxide or 0.1 M sodium hydroxide
details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix X B. Acid Value; BP 2024 Monograph for Synthetic Retinol Concentrate (Oily Form)

tests.procedure: Place 5.00 g (m) in a 250 mL stoppered conical flask. Add 30 mL of 2 volumes chloroform and 3 volumes glacial acetic acid, shake to dissolve. Add 0.5 mL saturated KI solution, shake exactly 1 min, add 30 mL CO2-free water. Titrate with 0.01 M sodium thiosulfate at 5 mL/min stirring magnetically, endpoint potentiometrically. Blank test (n2 mL, NMT 0.1 mL). Peroxide value IP = 10 x (n1 - n2) / m.

details.solvent: 30 mL chloroform : glacial acetic acid (2:3 V/V)
details.reagents: 0.5 mL saturated KI solution; 30 mL CO2-free water
details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix X F. Peroxide Value; BP 2024 Appendix VIII B Potentiometric (2.2.20); BP 2024 Monograph for Synthetic Retinol Concentrate (Oily Form)

tests.procedure: Dissolve 82.44 mg in 5 mL pentane, dilute 1.0 mL to 100 mL with 2-propanol, further dilute 1.0 mL to 20 mL with 2-propanol (~15 IU/g). Verify absorption maximum between 325 and 327 nm; measure absorbances at 300, 326, 350, 370 nm. Calculate ratios Aλ/A326 (NMT 0.60 at 300 nm, 0.54 at 350 nm, 0.14 at 370 nm). Content (IU/g) = A326 x V x 1900 / (100 x m). Compare to declared potency.

details.samplePrep: 82.44 mg in 5 mL pentane; 1.0 mL to 100 mL with 2-propanol; 1.0 mL to 20 mL with 2-propanol
details.formula: Content (IU/g) = A326 x V x 1900 / (100 x m); V = total volume (diluted to 10 IU/mL), m = sample mass (g), 1900 = conversion factor to IU/g
details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix II B. Ultraviolet and Visible Absorption Spectrophotometry; BP 2024 Monograph for Synthetic Retinol Concentrate (Oily Form)
